Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about MedCore's timeline for the pilot. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap next steps on the security/compliance side and kick off the SIG (Standard Information Gathering) questionnaire:

Summary of Redwood's posture (short):
- SOC 2: Type II in progress (scope: production serving, access controls). Target completion: 2027-06 (we can share interim control descriptions and a bridge letter).
- HIPAA: We sign BAAs; our hosting and data handling patterns support HIPAA-compliant deployments.
- GDPR: DPA available; we support EU data residency via region routing.

To make the SIG turnaround faster, could you confirm the following so we can prioritize answers?
1) Will the pilot involve PHI/PII at rest or only transiently in memory/streaming? (helps scope encryption and retention controls)
2) Do you have a preferred format for the SIG (Excel/DocuSign portal) or should we send the MedCore_SIG_v1.xlsx we attached?
3) Any specific controls you want us to call out (KMS usage, dedicated VPC, audit log retention length)?
4) Target completion date for the questionnaire on your side? You mentioned ~2 weeks — is that still accurate?

Attached: redwood_security_overview.pdf (high-level), MedCore_SIG_v1.xlsx (blank inventory we recommend).

Camila (cc) will own the SIG responses from our side and will loop in security as needed. If it helps, we can provide a draft answers file first for your review.

Next steps:
- Camila to propose an internal owner and timeframe for completing the initial SIG draft (I asked for 5 business days).
- Samir/Priya to confirm PHI/PII and preferred SIG format.

Thanks — look forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_security_overview.pdf; MedCore_SIG_v1.xlsx

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the summary — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our security team so we can scope the SIG: 

- PHI scope: The pilot will touch PHI (medical appointment summaries and identifiers) and we'll need BAA + clarity on at-rest encryption and key management.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood stores any customer-provided data at rest by default, or if storage is only on a short-lived layer unless configured?
- For SOC 2: will you be able to share interim evidence or a control matrix prior to the Type II report? Our procurement/security folks often need that while audit is in progress.
- Preferred SIG format: Excel is fine. We'll use the MedCore_SIG_v1.xlsx if you send a draft set of answers.

Timeline: 2 weeks for us to triage once we have the draft answers looks good. If you can provide a draft by EOD next Tue (Apr 27) that would help.

Appreciate you looping Camila in — she'll be our main contact for the questionnaire.
